title: Hermetic loopback HTTP/JSON-RPC/SSE conformance test suite for A2A, MCP 9090/9093, and GEMI
goal: Add an in-process loopback TcpListener HTTP/1.1 responder helper (spawn_loopback_http, read_http_request, MockReply) and hermetic end-to-end conformance unit tests exercising A2A agent-card honesty, unknown-method -32601, and streaming subscribe/resubscribe checks, MCP 9090 and alias 9093 discovery, tools/list, and 2025-06-18 Mcp-Session-Id handshake checks, and GEMI /v1/models path-leak warning plus /v1/chat/completions SSE stream checks in crates/susi-conformance/src/lib.rs (landed in 23c9c2052 #1384).

reuse.reason: Extended the existing susi-conformance black-box host-contract check functions and std::net::TcpListener loopback sockets inside crates/susi-conformance/src/lib.rs (landed in squash commit 23c9c2052a9bb3dbc6f055582dc417144b7f0c60 #1384) without adding new crates or external mock-server dependencies.
